Hero.description: I develop end-to-end custom web solutions, from modern user interfaces to robust backend services, with a strong background in Fintech.

About.p1: My name is Tahiry. With over 4 years of experience building modern applications, I develop custom digital solutions ranging from secure management platforms to scalable web and mobile apps.
About.p2: Having worked both as a Full-Stack Developer and Project Manager, I turn complex business requirements into clean, intuitive, and robust products without unnecessary technical jargon.
About.p3: While open to diverse industries, I hold deep hands-on expertise in financial systems: secure payment workflows (Stripe, gateways), invoicing platforms, and custom real-time dashboards.
About.p4: I oversee the full product lifecycle from architecture to production release, ensuring high performance, data reliability, and seamless user experiences.
